---
title: "Visualize non-concordance bin enrichment"
author: "CIG @ MGI"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

```{r config, include=FALSE}
# Repository location, separate from DATA_ROOT. Replace with the absolute path
# to your clone (the directory containing shared-R).
REPO_ROOT <- "/path/to/repo"
REPO_ROOT <- normalizePath(REPO_ROOT, mustWork = TRUE)
# Input locations. Set these before knitting.
DATA_ROOT <- "" # project data directory (per-analysis subdirectories)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
set.seed(0)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = file.path(DATA_ROOT, "RI_Personalization/CC_genotype_comparison_to_muga_array/"))

library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(scales)
library("dplyr")
library(factoextra)
library(tidyr)
source(file.path(REPO_ROOT, "shared-R", "CS_Aesthetic.R"))
source(file.path(REPO_ROOT, "shared-R", "JFMV_2025_Aesthetic.R"))
library(ggrepel)
library(gridExtra)
library(reshape2)
library(ggbeeswarm)

library(ComplexUpset)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(data.table)
```

```{r import_data}
fread("nonconcordance_bin_enrichment.bed") -> nonconcordance_bin_enrichment

nonconcordance_bin_enrichment$oe_ratio <- (nonconcordance_bin_enrichment$obs_mean_animals_per_site + 1) / (nonconcordance_bin_enrichment$null_mean_animals_per_site + 1)

dim(nonconcordance_bin_enrichment)
# leave in only primary autosomes and sex chromosomes
nonconcordance_bin_enrichment <- nonconcordance_bin_enrichment %>%
  filter(chrom %in% c(paste0("chr", 1:19), "chrX"))
dim(nonconcordance_bin_enrichment)

# apply fdr correction to empirical_p_upper
nonconcordance_bin_enrichment <- nonconcordance_bin_enrichment %>%
  group_by(outcome) %>%
  mutate(empirical_p_upper_fdr = p.adjust(empirical_p_upper, method = "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup()


```

```{r plot n_sites_in_bin distribution, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}

ggplot(nonconcordance_bin_enrichment, aes(x = n_sites_in_bin/1e3)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of n_sites_in_bin", x = "Number of Sites in Bin (thousands)", y = "Count") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = 'log10', labels = comma) +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = 'log10') +
  facet_wrap(~outcome, scales = "free_x") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 4.06, linetype = "dashed", color = "red")


ggplot(nonconcordance_bin_enrichment, aes(x = n_sites_in_bin/1e3)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of n_sites_in_bin", x = "Number of Sites in Bin (thousands)", y = "Count") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  scale_x_continuous() +
  facet_wrap(~outcome, scales = "free_x") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 4.06, linetype = "dashed", color = "red")

```

```{r plot obs_sum_animals distribution, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}

ggplot(nonconcordance_bin_enrichment, aes(x = obs_sum_animals)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of obs_sum_animals", x = "Observed Sum of Animals in Bin", y = "Count") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = 'log10', labels = comma) +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = 'log10') +
  facet_wrap(~outcome, scales = "free_x")

```


```{r plot oe_ratio distribution, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}

ggplot(nonconcordance_bin_enrichment, aes(x = oe_ratio)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of oe_ratio", x = "Observed/Expected Ratio in Bin", y = "Count") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = 'log10', labels = comma) +
  facet_wrap(~outcome, scales = "free_x") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2, linetype = "dashed", color = "red")

```


```{r plot empirical_p_upper distribution, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}

ggplot(nonconcordance_bin_enrichment, aes(x = empirical_p_upper)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of empirical_p_upper", x = "Empirical P-value (Upper Tail)", y = "Count") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  facet_wrap(~outcome, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.05, 1.05))

ggplot(nonconcordance_bin_enrichment, aes(x = empirical_p_upper_fdr)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of empirical_p_upper (FDR corrected)", x = "Empirical P-value (Upper Tail, FDR corrected)", y = "Count") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  facet_wrap(~outcome, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.05, 1.05))



Pval_Threshold <- 0.05

nonconcordance_bin_enrichment %>%
  group_by(outcome) %>%
  summarize(n_significant_bins = sum(empirical_p_upper < Pval_Threshold)) %>%
  ungroup()

# How many significant bins do we have at FDR < 0.05?
nonconcordance_bin_enrichment %>%
  group_by(outcome) %>%
  summarize(n_significant_bins = sum(empirical_p_upper_fdr < 0.005)) %>%
  ungroup()

```

```{r plot heatmap of enrichment, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
# Create a heatmap of oe_ratio for each bin and outcome
ggplot(nonconcordance_bin_enrichment, aes(x = start/1e6, y = outcome, fill = oe_ratio)) +
  geom_tile() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Heatmap of Observed/Expected Ratio by Bin and Outcome", x = "Bin Start Position (kb)", y = "Outcome") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) +
  facet_wrap(~chrom, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "turbo", na.value = "grey90", begin = 0.9, end = 0.1)

ggplot(nonconcordance_bin_enrichment, aes(x = start/1e6, y = outcome, fill = obs_mean_animals_per_site/40)) +
  geom_tile() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Heatmap of Mean Observed Animals per Site by Bin and Outcome", x = "Bin Start Position (kb)", y = "Outcome", fill = "Mean\nObserved\nAnimals/Site") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) +
  facet_wrap(~chrom, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", na.value = "grey90", begin = 0.9, end = 0.1)

```

```{r plot heatmap of obs summed, fig.width=8, fig.height=3}
# plot as above but take sum of obs_mean_animals_per_site across outcomes for each bin, and plot that as the fill color
bin_obs_mean_animals_per_site <- nonconcordance_bin_enrichment %>%
  group_by(chrom, start, end) %>%
  summarize(sum_obs_mean_animals_per_site = sum(obs_mean_animals_per_site/40)) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(bin_obs_mean_animals_per_site, aes(x = start/1e6, y = 1, fill = sum_obs_mean_animals_per_site)) +
  geom_tile() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Heatmap of Sum of Observed Animals per Site by Bin", x = "Bin Start Position (Mb)", y = "Chromosome", fill = "Sum\nObserved") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) +
  facet_wrap(~chrom, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "turbo", na.value = "grey90", begin = 0.9, end = 0.1) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank())

```

```{r plot heatmap of filtered summed, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
chrom_limits <- bin_obs_mean_animals_per_site %>%
  group_by(chrom) %>%
  summarize(
    x0 = min(start, na.rm = TRUE) / 1e6,
    x1 = max(end, na.rm = TRUE) / 1e6
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


ggplot(bin_obs_mean_animals_per_site, aes(x = start/1e6, y = 1, fill = sum_obs_mean_animals_per_site)) +
  geom_blank(data = chrom_limits, aes(x = x0, y = 1), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_blank(data = chrom_limits, aes(x = x1, y = 1), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_tile() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Heatmap of Sum of Observed Animals per Site by Bin",
    x = "Bin Start Position (Mb)",
    y = "Chromosome",
    fill = "Sum\nObserved"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) +
  facet_wrap(~chrom, scales = "free_x", ncol=2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", na.value = "grey90", begin = 0.9, end = 0.1) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank())



Threshold_SD_Multiplier <- 0
genome_wide_mean <- mean(bin_obs_mean_animals_per_site$sum_obs_mean_animals_per_site, na.rm = TRUE)

chrom_thresholds <- chrom_bind_obs_mean_animals_per_site__summary %>%
  mutate(threshold = mean + Threshold_SD_Multiplier * sd)

bin_obs_mean_animals_per_site_filtered <- bin_obs_mean_animals_per_site %>%
  left_join(chrom_thresholds %>% select(chrom, mean, sd, threshold), by = "chrom") %>%
  filter(sum_obs_mean_animals_per_site >= threshold & sum_obs_mean_animals_per_site >=0*genome_wide_mean)

ggplot(bin_obs_mean_animals_per_site_filtered, aes(x = start/1e6, y = 1, fill = sum_obs_mean_animals_per_site)) +
  geom_blank(data = chrom_limits, aes(x = x0, y = 1), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_blank(data = chrom_limits, aes(x = x1, y = 1), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_tile() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Heatmap of Sum of Observed Animals per Site by Bin",
    x = "Bin Start Position (Mb)",
    y = "Chromosome",
    fill = "Sum\nObserved"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) +
  facet_wrap(~chrom, scales = "free_x", ncol=2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", na.value = "grey90", begin = 0.9, end = 0.1) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank())

# save the filtered bins to a bed file
bin_obs_mean_animals_per_site_filtered %>%
  select(chrom, start, end, sum_obs_mean_animals_per_site) %>%
  fwrite("nonconcordance_bin_enrichment_filtered.bed", sep = "\t", col.names = FALSE)
```

```{r plot mean vs sd of mismatch obs summed, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}
  sd(subset(mismatch_bin_enrichment, chrom=="chr8")$obs_sum_animals, na.rm = TRUE),
  sd(subset(mismatch_bin_enrichment, chrom=="chr9")$obs_sum_animals, na.rm = TRUE),
  sd(subset(mismatch_bin_enrichment, chrom=="chr10")$obs_sum_animals, na.rm = TRUE),
  sd(subset(mismatch_bin_enrichment, chrom=="chr11")$obs_sum_animals, na.rm = TRUE),
  sd(subset(mismatch_bin_enrichment, chrom=="chr12")$obs_sum_animals, na.rm = TRUE),
  sd(subset(mismatch_bin_enrichment, chrom=="chr13")$obs_sum_animals, na.rm = TRUE),
  sd(subset(mismatch_bin_enrichment, chrom=="chr14")$obs_sum_animals, na.rm = TRUE),
  sd(subset(mismatch_bin_enrichment, chrom=="chr15")$obs_sum_animals, na.rm = TRUE),
  sd(subset(mismatch_bin_enrichment, chrom=="chr16")$obs_sum_animals, na.rm = TRUE),
  sd(subset(mismatch_bin_enrichment, chrom=="chr17")$obs_sum_animals, na.rm = TRUE),
  sd(subset(mismatch_bin_enrichment, chrom=="chr18")$obs_sum_animals, na.rm = TRUE),
  sd(subset(mismatch_bin_enrichment, chrom=="chr19")$obs_sum_animals, na.rm = TRUE),
  sd(subset(mismatch_bin_enrichment, chrom=="chrX")$obs_sum_animals, na.rm = TRUE)
)
) -> chrom_bind_obs_sum_animals_per_site__summary

# plot mean vs sd of sum_obs_mean_animals_per_site by chrom
ggplot(chrom_bind_obs_sum_animals_per_site__summary, aes(x = mean, y = sd)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Mean Sum of Observed Animals per Site in Bin", y = "SD of Sum of Observed Animals per Site in Bin") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = chrom), size = 3)

```

```{r plot heatmap of obs summed for mismatch only, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
ggplot(mismatch_bin_enrichment, aes(x = start/1e6, y = 1, fill = obs_mean_animals_per_site/40)) +
  geom_blank(data = chrom_limits, aes(x = x0, y = 1), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_blank(data = chrom_limits, aes(x = x1, y = 1), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_tile() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Heatmap of Mean Observed Animals per Site by Bin (Mismatch Only)",
    x = "Bin Start Position (Mb)",
    y = "Chromosome",
    fill = "Mean\nObserved\nAnimals/Site/40"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) +
  facet_wrap(~chrom, scales = "free_x", ncol=2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", na.value = "grey90", begin = 0.9, end = 0.1) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank())

# order chromosomes by natural order
mismatch_bin_enrichment$chrom <- factor(mismatch_bin_enrichment$chrom, levels = c(paste0("chr", 1:19), "chrX"))

ggplot(mismatch_bin_enrichment, aes(x = start/1e6, y = 1, fill = obs_sum_animals/1e5)) +
  geom_blank(data = chrom_limits, aes(x = x0, y = 1), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_blank(data = chrom_limits, aes(x = x1, y = 1), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_tile() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Heatmap of Sum of Observed Animals per Site by Bin (Mismatch Only)",
    x = "Bin Start Position (Mb)",
    y = "Chromosome",
    fill = "Sum\nObserved\nAnimals (x10^5)"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) +
  facet_wrap(~chrom, scales = "free_x", ncol=2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", na.value = "grey90", begin = 0.9, end = 0.1) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank())

#save the mismatch_bin_enrichment to a bed file
mismatch_bin_enrichment %>%
  select(chrom, start, end, obs_sum_animals) %>%
  fwrite("mismatch_bin_enrichment.bed", sep = "\t", col.names = FALSE)
```
